title: Gestingthorpe
description: A Romano-British villa site located in Gestingthorpe parish, Essex, that has been sampled through survey, magnetometry, and partial excavation. Artifact evidence indicates occupation from the first to the fourth centuries.

properties.description: 1:1 million scale representative point location digitized from the Barrington Atlas of the Greek and Roman World by the Digital Atlas of Roman and Medieval Civilizations project at Harvard University.
